name: Benipur

queries.query: Benipur Bihar cadastral parcel map official land records GIS
queries.result: First-party discovery found Bihar BhuNaksha, the Government of Bihar Directorate of Land Records & Survey cadastral map viewer, and the Bihar Revenue and Land Reforms service index. The official viewer exposes district, subdivision, circle, mouza, survey type, map instance, and sheet selectors.

queries.query: बेनीपुर बिहार भू नक्शा भूलेख सरकारी
queries.result: First-party discovery found the same Bihar Government BhuNaksha viewer and Darbhanga district government material identifying Benipur circle/mouza records. The BhuNaksha hierarchy returned Darbhanga (13), subdivision Benipur (02), circle Benipur (12), and the native mouza labels बेनीपुर(151) and बेनीपुर(151/2).

freshResearch.method: Separate English and Hindi first-party discovery, followed by bounded TLS-verified GET/POST requests and current JavaScript/configuration inspection; no credentials, private tokens, login, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, unsafe-field request, or TLS disablement.

source.custodian: Directorate of Land Records & Survey, Government of Bihar; NIC implementation identified on the official viewer
source.selectedHierarchy: state Bihar (10) / district Darbhanga (13) / subdivision Benipur (02) / circle Benipur (12) / mouza बेनीपुर(151) (1004) / Revisional Survey (RS) / RS Map (07) / sheet 01
source.crs: Service extent response reported EPSG:32645; no geometry was retained.

portalsFound.observation: Official public cadastral map viewer; current index.js references REST endpoints for hierarchy, map extent, plot-at-coordinate lookup, WMS rendering, and plot details. The page identifies the Directorate of Land Records & Survey, Government of Bihar.

Official Directorate service index lists Online Map, Online Revenue Records, Online Jamabandi, and related land-record services. This is agency/service evidence, while the BhuNaksha viewer is the local map route used for Benipur.
Official Darbhanga district site was found in native-language discovery; search evidence includes Benipur circle/mouza planning material. It was not used as a parcel geometry source.

requests.assessment: Current configuration showed relative SERVICE_PATH and COMMON_SERVER_PATH; no credentials or private token.
Current JavaScript exposed REST/Levels, REST/MapInfo, ScalarDatahandler, and WMS routes; schema and request parameter names were inspected.

requests.responseSummary: Returned Darbhanga hierarchy; Benipur subdivision/circle path was identified.
Returned circle Benipur code 12 and its mouza list.
Returned mouza बेनीपुर(151) code 1004, बेनीपुर(151/2) code 1005, RS/CS survey choices, RS Map code 07, and sheets 01/02.
Returned GIS code RS13021210041510701, EPSG:32645, and a non-null map extent for the Benipur mouza RS sheet. This is map extent evidence, not a parcel feature response.

requests.requestSummary: Three bounded coordinate probes against gisCode RS13021210041510701: (200000,1400000), (191.4,206.6), and (300000,1000000).
requests.assessment: No plot object was returned. These arbitrary service-coordinate probes were not treated as exact WUP-point hits/misses and do not establish citywide absence.
Capabilities request returned an empty 500 response; no further WMS request was used to infer parcel geometry.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Bihar Government BhuNaksha cadastral map service, with a verified Benipur circle/mouza map path in Darbhanga district.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Public viewer hierarchy and non-null map extent for one Benipur mouza RS sheet; no safe anonymous parcel ID-plus-geometry response was obtained.

remainingUncertainty: Native parcel identity fields, parcel geometry endpoint/schema, map extent semantics, complete Benipur urban coverage, update currency, and exact WUP-point parcel membership remain unresolved. The exact WUP point was preserved and never shifted. Packet completion records research evidence only; it is not source integration or runtime admission.
